en:
Well, now. So it's finally my turn.
To be honest, I didn't really want to talk, but it can't be helped.
...I'll let you in on my secret.
Oops, before that, I'd better introduce myself.
My name is Nozomu Kazama.
I'm a third-year.
I know everything there is to know about this school, so if there's anything you don't know, just ask me, {c}{f:|}.
...Oh, dear.
This is hard to talk about, somehow.
I wonder if I should really be telling a story like this...{p}{c}{f:|}, do you want to know my secret?
I want to know
I don't want to know
I don't care either way

Listen.
Don't be shocked when you hear this.

...The truth is, I'm a spirit medium.
Did you just laugh?{p}Did you laugh inside, {c}{f:|}?
I laughed
I didn't laugh
To be honest, I laughed a little

Good, good, you're a good {f:guy|girl}.
From now on, I'll take you under my wing.
If you ever have any trouble, come to me for advice.
What? You don't care about that?
You want me to hurry up and tell a scary story?
Hm hm hm... You mustn't be so impatient.{p}

You see, I didn't come here to tell a scary story.
I came to show you something scary.
Are you ready?
Then allow me to show you my powers as a spirit medium.
Close the curtains... yes, and turn off the lights too, if you would.{p}

...It's pitch black.
It's already quite late, and it's pitch black.
At times like this, spirits naturally gather.
We're already on the fourth scary story.
By now, the wandering spirits drifting around here must be starting to take an interest in this atmosphere, don't you think?{p}

...There, listen closely.
Can't you hear something like the sound of the wind?
Mixed in with that wind, can't you hear the bitter moans of a woman who killed herself over a broken heart, cursing this world she left behind?
There...{p}

Listen.
That's spirit rapping.{p}

The spirits are starting to gather.
Don't be afraid.
If you're afraid, the spirits will take advantage of you.
Keep your heart calm.{p}

Calm down... calm down... listen carefully to what I tell you.
If you do, the sounds will stop.
Silence will settle over the room again.
Now... calm down... calm down.{p}

There, see?
The sounds stopped.{p}
{c}{f:|}, if you're scared, you can turn the lights on, you know.
Turn on the lights
It's fine like this

I see.
You don't want to turn the lights on.
You've made the wrong choice.
You're going to taste an even greater terror.

Uh-oh!
The spirits are angry.
Did you just make fun of the spirits?
Did you laugh to yourself, thinking something like this couldn't possibly happen?
If you thought that, you'd better apologize to the spirits.
Then they should calm down.

It's no good!
You're mocking them.
If I don't hold them back, the spirits are going to run wild!
Please, calm yourselves.
We are not mocking you.
Please, return to where you came from.{p}

...Kazama was holding a Styrofoam box.
"Isn't that just dry ice★"
The girl sitting in with us pointed straight at Kazama.
Inside the box was dry ice, giving off white smoke...
So that ectoplasm had been nothing but {f:dry ice smoke|dry ice smoke}?{p}

"You guys think this looks like dry ice?
These are spirits, chilled until they froze solid."
What is {f:this guy|this guy} even talking about?
Then the girl pressed him further.{p}

"It's fine.
I'm a spirit medium, so I can do whatever I want.
You're awfully noisy, aren't you?
Keep saying things like that and the spirits will curse you."
Kazama had turned completely defiant.
Everyone was looking at Kazama in exasperation.
{f:Naturally.|Of course they were.}
"...You people are so narrow-minded.
You ought to be able to take a little joke.
I really was just about to summon some spirits."
Kazama was utterly unrepentant.{p}

"...What's with those looks, all of you?
Got some complaint with me?
I was trying to give you all a good scare, and... oh, forget it.
Let's hurry up and hear the next guy's story.
If it's boring, I'll knock your block off."
With that, Kazama turned away in a huff.
What on earth {f:is with this guy|is with this guy}?
...Oh, great, now he's totally sulking.
{f:Can't be helped.|Oh, well.}
{f:Well, then|All right, then}, let's hear the next person's story.{p}

Ah, saying that won't do you any good.
I have a special power, you see. I can read your mind.
You want to know my secret.
The secret of me, Nozomu Kazama.
Admiring a man of my caliber is {f:just something nobody can help, boy or girl|only natural for a girl}.
It's nothing to be embarrassed about.
So I'll answer the wish hidden deep in your heart.
I'll tell you my secret.{p}

...The truth is, I was born on January 1st.
So I'm a Virgo, blood type AB.
My favorite color is marine blue.{p}My lucky item is canned salmon.
What is he even talking about?
I just heard something amazing

{f:So|You see}, for {f:gals|people} like that, I've offered to let the newspaper club do a feature on me.
Huh? The next feature is the school's seven wonders?
Well, who cares about that?{p}A feature on me would make a much better paper, I'm sure.
...Maybe he's right
Please be serious

Then, the next day,
{f:I|I} was called in by Hino.{p}

"{a}, how's it going?
Is the seven wonders feature shaping up well?"
Hino was smiling kindly.
...This might be bad.
I had dropped the seven wonders feature on my own and gone and interviewed {f:the likes of Kazama|Kazama} instead.
{f:Was I going to get chewed out?|Would he be angry with me?}
"Um, Hino, actually... uh, about the next feature... could we drop the seven wonders?"
{f:I|I} finally managed to say just that much.{p}

"Huh? Why?"
"...{f:I|I} promised I'd do a feature on this guy Kazama.
And I've already done the whole interview..."

"What did you say?"
"I'm sorry!
But you're partly to blame too, Hino.
You're the one who invited Kazama, aren't you?
I just sort of got swept along at his pace."
...Hino fell silent, dumbfounded.
{f:But|But} it was too late to change the interview content now.{p}

{f:I|I} ran the feature on Nozomu Kazama.
The response was tremendous.
{f:My|My} choice {f:had been the right one after all|had been right, it seemed}.
But Hino went on frowning for a long time after.{p}

Then one day after school, {f:I|I} {f:saw it|saw it}.
"If you were going to run a feature on Kazama, you should've run one on me..."
Hino, grumbling those words at the wall...
Hmm, maybe this is the real scary story from school.
{f:I|I} stood frozen in the shadows for a while...{p}

...{f:You're a rude guy|That's so mean of you}, you know.
Here I {f:went out of my way to throw|am, going out of my way to throw} the topic your way.
At a time like this,
"Yes, please, do tell me!"
...{f:is the least|or something like that,}{f: you could say| is what I'd hoped you'd say}.{p}

Well, fine.
{f:I was|You're}{f: a fool to expect| nervous too, I bet, and}{f: any thoughtfulness from the likes of you.| just couldn't think of a good answer right away, right?}
Anyway, let's get on with it.
My secret...... is this.
The truth is, I can hear the voice of God.
God is always speaking to me, teaching me a better way to live.
...What's wrong, {c}{f:|}?
Why are you backing away like that?
You're acting like I'm some kind of dangerous person.{p}
Ah, don't tell me you think I'm lying?
I do think so
No, not at all!

...You do think so, huh?
So you think I'm lying★{p}You mean to say there's no way I could hear the voice of God★
There's no way you could hear it
Maybe you really can hear it

...So that's what you think after all.
A man who hears the voice of God and prophesies the end of the world... that'd be a pretty odd one for the seven wonders, huh.
And here I thought it was a good idea.
Oh well, if I've been found out, there's no helping it.{p}

Still, you're {f:a rude guy|a naughty girl}, aren't you.
I tell you I can hear it, and you won't believe me.
{f:You've got no manners toward your seniors|That's not something I can forgive}.
Thanks to you, I'll have to rethink my idea.
Kazama folded his arms and started muttering something under his breath.
{f:I bet he was|I just knew he was} thinking up more nonsense like that again.
{f:Could it be that|I wondered if} this guy didn't even understand what the project was about?
But if I said that, he'd {f:go on again about manners toward seniors|start in again with 'what a naughty girl'}; {f:I'd get a lecture for sure|I just knew it}.
...{f:I|I} sighed.
From here on, with this guy,
"Leave the gods alone, and they won't curse you,"
as the saying goes. That's how I'd play it.
Now then, who should I ask to tell the next story{f:|}?{p}

Not 'maybe.' I really can hear it.
Even you can tell I'm different from the people around me, surely.{p}

...Yes, that's the right answer.
If you don't believe what I say, misfortune will come to you, after all.
God speaks directly into my head, you see.
"This school is cursed."
...like that.
It seems something evil has a hold on this school.
And not just one or two of them, either. A huge number of them, apparently.
And now, God has entrusted me with a new prophecy.
Listen closely. I'll only say this once.
What God said was......
"Stop telling the stories of the seven wonders."
That's the message.
If we keep telling stories like these, the evil things lurking in this school will catch on and come closer, God says.
I think I can feel it, too.{p}

See, can't you feel it?
Like the fine hairs on your back are standing on end, like something is slowly seeping in through your pores...
Something may already be lurking in that darkness over there.
It's lying in wait, ready to sink its teeth into us the instant we let our guard down, even a little.
Maybe you can't sense it.{p}
...Well? Are you still going to go on with this project?{p}Like God says, don't you think it'd be better to stop now?
Stop
Keep going

"...Let's stop."
{f:I|I} said.
Someone made a disgruntled noise.
But most of them seemed to feel the same way {f:I|I} did.
{f:Of course they did|Naturally}.
That presence lurking in the dark that Kazama talked about... you really could feel it.{p}

There really was something in that darkness.
Of course, {f:I had no desire at all to find out what it was|I have no desire at all to find out what it is}.
{f:I|I} value my life too.
The presence was {f:that dangerous|just that dangerous}.
...Who knows, maybe Kazama only brought up 'God' because he actually just wanted to get out of here himself{f:|}.{p}

{f:We|We} stood up.
So as not to give the {f:thing|presence} in the dark an opening, we filed out of the club room in a tight cluster.{p}

When I turned back to shut the door, for an instant I saw two eyes grinning at me from the darkness... or I thought I did.
{f:I|I} hurriedly shut the door.{p}

Nobody asked when the next meeting would be.
Everyone knew there wouldn't be a next time, {f:I suppose|I guess}.
We should count ourselves lucky just to have escaped with our lives.
{f:This project was something we never should have done|We never should have done this project}.
The school I knew so well suddenly seemed like something eerie.
Never again would I do this project.
{f:I|I} swore that firmly to myself.{p}

...{f:Huh|Oh}, you've got guts, don't you.
Or are you {f:a huge idiot who doesn't know when to back down|just someone with a strong sense of justice}?
Well, if that's how it is, fine.
But I did warn you properly.
If you ignore God's voice and keep going and something happens, {f:it's on you|you'll be in big trouble}.
{f:Remember that well|Be careful, okay}.
...All right, next person, go ahead.{p}
What, you don't believe me?{p}You talk about the seven wonders, but you don't believe in this kind of thing yourself, do you?
I do believe
I don't believe

Really, now?
...Oh well, whatever.
In that case, I'll summon your guardian spirit and tell your fortune.
Kindly turn off the lights.{p}

...Look!
That glowing white light, that's your guardian spirit.
...It's saying something.
Let me see... DO NOT... END THE SIXTH...?
The sixth what? What do you mean?
Guardian spirit!{p}

Ah...... it's gone.
The sixth... could it mean the sixth story of these seven wonders?
It said it mustn't be allowed to end, didn't it.
But with the seven wonders, they say something happens once you learn all of them, up to the seventh story.
So why, this time of all times, would it say something about the sixth?
Besides, if the seventh person doesn't show up, the stories won't be complete in the first place.
Something's strange about this......{p}

The lights came on.
Kazama was lost in thought, looking puzzled.
I'd thought it was just a prank, but it seemed {f:I was wrong|I was wrong}.
So was Kazama really a medium after all{f:|}?
He doesn't look like one, though...
As {f:I|I} stared at him, Kazama {f:waved a hand at me irritably|smiled sweetly and said}.
"That was the fourth story.
I've got some thinking to do.
Don't mind me, carry on."
...I guess I'll do that{f:|}.
{f:Now then|Well then}, who should I ask to tell the next story?{p}

{f:You're hopeless|Hey now}, {f:that won't do at all|that's not good}.
If you don't believe it yourself, how do you expect the project to succeed?
Believing and charging ahead, isn't that what they call journalistic spirit?
{f:Face it|Come on}, {f:you're not cut out for this, are you|don't you think so}?{p}

...Oh, you're sulking.
Are you mad?
{f:Getting angry over a little thing like that|Sorry, sorry}, {f:you'd never make it as a journalist|I didn't mean to bully you}.
Once you're out on a real interview, getting yelled at or treated like a nuisance happens all the time{f:|, you know}.
{f:Just as I thought,|You'd better} {f:you're not up to the job|get used to this kind of thing}.
I was going to tell you my very best scary story, but {f:forget it|I'll hold off for now}.
{f:I can't tell it to the likes of you|But if you ever want to hear it, come find me}.
{f:If you want to blame someone,|I'll tell it to you} {f:blame your own immaturity|anytime}.
Now then, on to the next one.{p}

{f:How rude|That's mean}.
I'll give you credit for honesty, though.
But you mustn't laugh carelessly.
Spirits are always watching you.
If you laugh without thinking, a spirit will think you're mocking it and get angry.
...See, it's angry right now.
Can you see it, there in that darkness?
It's angry at you.
At this rate, your life will be in danger.
You want to be saved, don't you?{p}Can you do exactly as I say?
I'll do as you say
I can't promise that

All right, you're pretty sensible.
Now then, {f:take off your right indoor shoe|first, come over here}.
{f:Put it on your head|Put your hand on mine}.{p}Come on, hurry up.
Put it on
Don't put it on

...Good, that's it.
{f:Now stand up slowly|The important part comes next}.
{f:Standing at attention,|Together with me,} {f:spin around three times|you're going to dance a waltz}.{p}{f:And while you do,|Now,} {f:try not to breathe if you can|first comes the twirling step}.
Spin around
Don't spin

Good, that's it.
{f:One|Laa}... {f:two|laa}... {f:and that's three|la-la-laa}.{p}

Ahaha, you're such a trusting soul.
You totally bought it, huh.
Was I really that intense?
{f:Not that I've ever heard|Your dancing was really great,} {f:of anyone calming spirits that way|but it was only a joke}.

Ahahahaha.
...Huh, are you mad?
Sorry, sorry. But you started it, laughing at what I said.
{f:It was just a little payback, that's all|Just a little payback, you know}.
Don't be so mad...
Kazama was grinning.
What happened to the whole medium thing{f:|}?
...But {f:I|I} didn't ask.
I was done getting mixed up with this guy{f:|}.
Better hurry on to the next story before he comes up with something weird again.{p}

{f:You're hopeless|This is a problem}.
So you won't listen to my kind advice.
...Can't be helped, then.
If anything happens to you, {f:don't come crying to me|I can't take responsibility}.
I did warn you properly.
Tomorrow, a month from now, a year from now... either way, something is going to happen to you.
When it does, it'll be too late for regrets.
Kazama's story was over.
He was grinning.
Was all of that a lie?
...I hoped so.
But what if...
{f:I|I} desperately held down my rising anxiety.
"N... next person, please."{p}

All right, then turn on the lights.
At Kazama's word, someone turned on the lights.{p}

"Well, do you believe me now?
I really am a medium, you know."
Kazama looked pleased with himself.
He had one hand behind his back, fumbling with something.
What {f:was he up to|could he be doing}?
"Hey, this guy's got a tape recorder hidden on him!"
A girl sitting in with us shouted at the top of her voice.{p}

"Hey, hey, keep your voice down.
Well, if I've been found out, there's no helping it..."{p}

Without a shred of shame, Kazama set the tape recorder he'd been holding behind his back on the desk.
Don't tell me all those creepy sounds were coming from this tape recorder?{p}

"How could you, Kazama!"
"Why? What's the problem?
You came to a project like this on purpose because you wanted to get scared, right?
So I went to the trouble of preparing something like this to live up to your expectations, didn't I?"
......He wasn't the least bit sorry.
This was too much{f:|}.
Why did someone like him have to show up{f:|}?
Just then, the girl spoke.{p}

"Hey... more importantly, who was it that turned on the lights just now?"
What was she talking about{f:|}?
{f:I|I} casually looked around at everyone.

...Huh?
Nobody said anything.
"The person who turned on the lights.
It has to be someone here."
Still, no one spoke up to say it was them.
Everyone was glancing around at each other, sizing each other up.
The girl's face looked pale.
"I knew it.
When this guy said to turn on the lights, I didn't sense anyone move at all, but the lights just suddenly came on."
{f:What|Whaaat}★
Then are you saying the lights came on by themselves{f:|}★{p}

Even Kazama looked startled.
Did that mean there was something here besides {f:us|us}{f:|}?
I had a feeling that if we kept telling stories, something bad would happen.
...And yet {f:my|my} mouth, all on its own, was saying this:
"...Well then, next person, please."{p}

What a thing to say.
I'm being completely serious here.{p}

...Well, fine.
{f:Pearls before swine,|As for my secrets,} {f:gold coins before cats|I've got more where that came from}.
{f:Talking to someone who doesn't get it is a waste of breath|A good man is always wrapped in mystery}.
{f:Oh well|All right}.
I suppose I'll tell you another of my secrets.
Mind you, this one's a step down in quality from the beautiful profile of yours truly.{p}

Listen.
Don't be shocked.
The truth is, I'm a medium.
...Hm hm hm.{p}
